verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is a crawling/extraction tool, not an analytics dashboard, but it offers LLM-based extraction, adaptive crawling with 'information foraging' to answer queries, and query-driven extraction (e.g. 'Extract all product prices'), which give AI-generated structured insights from crawled data. This is extraction/summarization rather than proactive insights/suggestions on the user's own stored data, so it only partially matches the story's intent.
